subtopics.content: 1.1 - 1.2 Basic safety rules, protective devices, fire extinguishers
subtopics.objective: Basic safety relating to personnel, tools, equipment, environment. Identification of safety devices (aprons, goggles). Types and usage of fire extinguishers (foam, dry powder, sand, water, wet-blanket).

subtopics.content: 2.1 - 2.3 Hand tools, power tools, measuring instruments, basic equipment
subtopics.objective: Identification and usage of hand tools, power tools, measuring instruments, and shop equipment (jacks, hoists, air-compressors).

subtopics.content: 3.1 - 3.3 Vehicle layout, main components, drive arrangements
subtopics.objective: Conventional motor vehicle layout inspection and functions of main components. Understanding drive arrangements: Front-Engine Rear-Wheel (FERW), Rear-Engine Rear-Wheel (RERW), Front-Engine Front-Wheel (FEFW), and Four-Wheel Drive (4WD).

subtopics.content: 4.1 - 4.7 Classification, cycles, crank arrangement, valve mechanism
subtopics.objective: Petrol vs diesel classification and main engine parts. Principles of 2-stroke and 4-stroke cycles. Single vs multi-cylinder engines, compression testing, measuring bore/journal wear. Crank arrangements and firing orders (in-line, V-4, V-6, horizontally opposed). Valve timing, calculations, valve adjustments, and decarbonization.

subtopics.content: 5.1 - 5.4 Fuels/combustion, petrol systems, petrol injection, diesel systems
subtopics.objective: Elements of combustion, air-fuel ratios, petrol vs diesel properties. Gravity vs force-feed petrol systems, carburetors, fuel pumps. Electronic Fuel Injection (EFI) merits. Diesel fuel layout, injection pumps, injectors, cold starting devices, and fuel bleeding.
Purpose and layout of exhaust system; identifying inlet and exhaust manifolds, silencer types, and checking for system leakage.

subtopics.content: 7.1 - 7.3 Engine lubrication, feed types, oil pumps, lubricants
subtopics.objective: Boundary layer vs film lubrication. Splash, forced, and petroil feed (wet/dry sump). Operation of gear/rotor oil pumps and filters. Lubricant applications, viscosity ratings (SAE numbers), changing oil/filters, grease gun usage.

subtopics.content: 8.1 - 8.3 Water cooling system, thermostats, air cooling system
subtopics.objective: Heat transfer principles. Thermo-syphon, pump-assisted, and pressurized water cooling systems. Thermostat types (bellows, wax pellet) and fault diagnosis. Air cooling layout and comparison with water cooling.
